decision: Do not add a wrong-correlation test as stale-generation evidence. Successive WorkerLink instances can each allocate corr1 for initial Subscribe. An old completion rerouted by Host to a successor with the same channel/corr is not distinguishable by this client. A fabricated unequal corr would test no-match policy only.

remaining: Core must fence a completion captured under a retired role/generation from writing or resolving a successor's pending Subscribe. Requires the shared-owner Core handler/install_generation tests plus actual Windows integration.
